BrandButtonsPage.title: Brand buttons
BrandButtonsPage.description: Buttons for other services: the brand's mark and name on an outline button.
BrandButtonsPage.brand_colors: Marksheet does not carry brand colors: the mark keeps the ink color of the button.

StandardButtonsPage.title: Buttons
StandardButtonsPage.description: Every button variant, size and state, as printed tabs on a white ply.
StandardButtonsPage.standard_description: Marksheet has no Bootstrap color set, so each row shows the button variants instead.
StandardButtonsPage.outline_description: Use OutlinedButton for a bordered button on the white ply.
StandardButtonsPage.ghost_description: Use TextButton for a text-only button that fills while pressed.
StandardButtonsPage.square_description: Give the button a RoundedRectangleBorder without a radius for square corners.
StandardButtonsPage.pill_description: Give the button a StadiumBorder for pill buttons.
StandardButtonsPage.sizes_description: Four heights: 32, 36, 44 and 52 pt. Normal is the app's own button; the smaller ones keep a 48 pt touch area.
StandardButtonsPage.icons_description: Icons sit before the label; icon-only buttons carry a tooltip that names them.
StandardButtonsPage.toggle_description: All six toggles share one pressed state: tap any of them.
StandardButtonsPage.block_description: Set minimumSize: Size.fromHeight(…) to fill the width of the container.

DropdownsPage.title: Button dropdowns
DropdownsPage.description: Menus opened from a button: dividers, headers, positions, sizes and split buttons.
DropdownsPage.positioning_description: Align the menu to either edge, open it upwards or nudge it with an offset.
DropdownsPage.caret_description: An icon trigger without a caret; its tooltip names it instead.
DropdownsPage.aria_description: Items are grouped under labelled headers so screen readers announce each group.
DropdownsPage.variants_description: Every button variant can open a menu.

ButtonGroupsPage.title: Button groups
ButtonGroupsPage.description: Buttons joined into one control, toolbars of groups, and toggle groups.
ButtonGroupsPage.basic_description: Inner corners square off and borders overlap; a few buttons drop out on a phone.
ButtonGroupsPage.dropdown_description: A dropdown, a nested submenu and a split dropdown inside one group.
ButtonGroupsPage.toolbar_description: Groups, inputs and menus side by side in a toolbar.
ButtonGroupsPage.toolbar_inputs_label: Toolbar with button groups and inputs
ButtonGroupsPage.toolbar_menu_label: Toolbar with button groups and a dropdown menu
ButtonGroupsPage.toggle_description: A group that keeps one choice, and one that keeps several.
